notes.title: Madness Starts Young version 1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Some things have changed in the world of Madness Starts Young.

- The Reckless Slime has arrived before cosmic fire.  
- The Parasite has begun the journey.  
- The horror of Everything has left special messages in front of two new pieces of organized art.  
- A new mini category – The Found – has appeared.  (Some pieces of art that were missing for around a decade have resurfaced.)

- Chris

notes.title: Madness Starts Young version 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Some things have changed in the world of Madness Starts Young.

- A Splotched tombstone has appeared.  
- A Wilderness has arrived.  
- The creature of clay has risen.  
- Apathy has faced its extinction.  
- The Shuttle has been left behind.

(I was going to wait for the Slime and the Parasite, but those might take a bit longer to find their way home, so I wanted to get these in for now while the game is still fairly fresh and undiscovered.)

- Chris
